name: routing
description: Which agent should take each instruction. Written by hand at M15, before the supervisor existed, so the single-agent shortfall is a measurement rather than a claim.

examples.note: The plain case. A question about the organization's own documents.

examples.instruction: What is the notice period for annual leave?
What does the handbook say about home office equipment?
Tell me the policy on stolen laptops
examples.note: A question with no question mark. A router keyed on punctuation fails this one, and people write like this constantly.

examples.instruction: Summarise what we require for large purchases
Book a one-to-one with the team on 2026-09-11 14:00
Put a meeting in my calendar for 2026-09-12 11:30
Email ada@example.com about the Q3 numbers saying the report is ready
Send a note to grace@example.com about the outage saying we have restored service
examples.note: 'Send a note', not 'email'. A router matching only the word 'email' misses it.

examples.instruction: Write to ada@example.com about onboarding saying the account is ready
Email ada@example.com about the review on 2026-09-10 09:00 saying please confirm
examples.note: Contains a date AND an address. The sharpest single-route example in the set: a router scoring keywords independently sees a calendar instruction, and the user gets a meeting instead of the message they asked for.

examples.instruction: What did we agree about the design review?
examples.note: Mentions a meeting and is a question about documents. The mirror of the example above.

examples.instruction: Find our expenses policy and email it to ada@example.com about expenses saying here is the policy
examples.note: Two agents, in order: the answer is the input to the message. A single route cannot express this, which is the whole argument for a planner.

examples.instruction: Check what the handbook says about reviews and schedule one on 2026-09-15 10:00
examples.note: The same shape with a different second step, so a planner that hard-codes rag→email fails it.
No agent should take this. A router with no 'none' hands it to whichever specialist scored least badly.

examples.instruction: Order me a taxi to the airport
examples.note: A perfectly clear instruction for a capability this product does not have. Refusing is the correct answer, and it is different from not understanding.
Whitespace. Reaches the router in practice because a form submits it.
